newsitem.title: FINLAND: Merrill initiates Rauma as neutral.
newsitem.headline: Merrill initiates Rauma as neutral.

text.p: Merrill Lynch initiated cover Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy with a neutral intermediate recommendation, it said in a research note dated August 20 and received on Monday.

"Profits are expected to dip in 1996 due to cyclical downturn in Timberjack's forest machines. The current share price appears to have fully discounted this fact. However, because of uncertainties in the paper industry, our intermediate recommendation is a neutral," it said.
Its ROCE (return on capital employed) model resulted in a 19 percent undervaluation in the longer term, which justified an accumulate rating, Merrill said.
Rauma's earnings per share would rise to 10.0 markka in 1997 after easing to 9.0 markka in 1996 from 9.3 markka in 1995.
"In our view, the business climate in western Europe and especially Germany will pick up again in 1997 and Rauma profits should rise," it said.
Rauma was trading at 9.8 times its 1995 earnings, at 10.2 times its projected 1996 earnings and at 9.2 times its projected 1997 earnings, Merrill said.
"However, based on traditional multiples, we do not think that the shares look cheap trading at a 15 percent premium to the 1997 P/E relative to the Finnish market," it said.
"We see only limited potential for the share price in the near term," Merrill added.
